```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(data.table)
source("C:/Users/klochhea/castor/R/functions/R_Postgres.R")
library(fasterize)
lu<-getSpatialQuery("SELECT wkb_geometry 
FROM public.rmp_lu_sp_polygon limit 1")

ProvRast <- raster(
  nrows = 15744, ncols = 17216, xmn = 159587.5, xmx = 1881187.5, ymn = 173787.5, ymx = 1748187.5, 
  crs = st_crs(lu)$proj4string, resolution = c(100, 100), vals = 0
)
```

## Protections layer

```{r}
prots<-st_read("C:/Users/klochhea/Downloads/ForestHarvestingRestrictions.gdb")
prots.table<-data.table(st_drop_geometry(prots))
protect<-prots[prots$rr_restriction_rollup %in% c('01_Protected', '02_Prohibited'), ]
protect$protect<-1

prot.ras<-fasterize::fasterize(sf= protect, raster = ProvRast , field = "protect")
prot.ras[is.na(prot.ras[])]<-0
writeRaster(prot.ras, "prot.tif",overwrite=TRUE)
prot.ras[prot.ras[]==1,]<-2
prot.ras[prot.ras[]==0,]<-1
prot.ras[prot.ras[]==2,]<-0

#Priority Deferral
deferral<-raster("C:/Users/klochhea/castor/prioirty_deferral.tif")
incr_pri<-prot.ras*deferral
writeRaster(incr_pri, "incr_pri_old.tif",overwrite=TRUE)

```

## Overlap with habitat

```{r}
if(FALSE){
columbia<-getSpatialQuery("SELECT 1 as hab, wkb_geometry FROM public.fisher_habitat_zones_2020 where hab_zone != 'Boreal'")
columbia.ras<-fasterize::fasterize(sf= columbia, raster = ProvRast , field = "hab")
columbia.ras[is.na(columbia.ras[])]<-0
}

if(FALSE){
  rcb<-getSpatialQuery("select   1 as aoi, wkb_geometry from public.nat_dr where region_org = 'RCB'")
  rcb.ras<-fasterize::fasterize(sf= rcb, raster = ProvRast , field = "aoi")
  rcb.ras[is.na(rcb.ras[])]<-0
}

if(FALSE){
  current_suitable<-st_read("C:/Users/klochhea/fetaMapper/data-raw/feta_v1.shp")
  current_suitable<-current_suitable[current_suitable$d2 <=7,]
  current_suitable$suitable<-1
  current_suitable.ras<-fasterize::fasterize(sf= current_suitable, raster = ProvRast , field = "suitable")
  current_suitable.ras[is.na(current_suitable.ras[])]<-0
  
}

### what area to focus on?
aoi.ras<-rcb.ras

prot.ras<-raster("C:/Users/klochhea/fetaMapper/data-raw/prot.tif")
prot.ras[is.na(prot.ras[])]<-0
og_def<-raster("C:/Users/klochhea/fetaMapper/data-raw/incr_pri_old.tif")
og_def[is.na(og_def[])]<-0
thlb<-raster("C:/Users/klochhea/fetaMapper/data-raw/thlb2020.tif")
thlb[is.na(thlb[])]<-0

thlb2<-1-thlb


prot.ras2<-prot.ras+thlb2
prot.ras2[prot.ras2[]>1]<-1

prot.ras2<-prot.ras2*aoi.ras
og_def2<-og_def*aoi.ras

#denning
denning<-raster("C:/Users/klochhea/fetaMapper/data-raw/denning.tif")
denning[is.na(denning[])]<-0.0
denning[]<-as.numeric(denning[])
denning<-denning*aoi.ras

den.prot<-denning * prot.ras2
den.def<-denning * og_def2
denning.sum<-data.table(hab = 'denning', total =sum(denning[], na.rm=T) , legal_prot = sum(den.prot[], na.rm=T), og_def = sum(den.def[], na.rm=T))


rust<-raster("C:/Users/klochhea/fetaMapper/data-raw/rest_rust.tif")
rust<-rust*aoi.ras
rust.prot<-rust * prot.ras2
rust.def<-rust * og_def2
rust.sum<-data.table(hab = 'rust', total =sum(rust[], na.rm=T) , legal_prot = sum(rust.prot[], na.rm=T), og_def = sum(rust.def[], na.rm=T))

cwd<-raster("C:/Users/klochhea/fetaMapper/data-raw/rest_cwd.tif")
cwd<-cwd*aoi.ras
cwd.prot<-cwd * prot.ras2
cwd.def<-cwd * og_def2
cwd.sum<-data.table(hab = 'cwd', total =sum(cwd[], na.rm=T) , legal_prot = sum(cwd.prot[], na.rm=T), og_def = sum(cwd.def[], na.rm=T))

cav<-raster("C:/Users/klochhea/fetaMapper/data-raw/rest_cavity.tif")
cav<-cav*aoi.ras
cav.prot<-cav * prot.ras2
cav.def<-cav * og_def2
cav.sum<-data.table(hab = 'cavity', total =sum(cav[], na.rm=T) , legal_prot = sum(cav.prot[], na.rm=T), og_def = sum(cav.def[], na.rm=T))


mov<-raster("C:/Users/klochhea/fetaMapper/data-raw/movement.tif")
mov<-mov*aoi.ras
mov.prot<-mov * prot.ras2
mov.def<-mov * og_def2
mov.sum<-data.table(hab = 'movement', total =sum(mov[], na.rm=T) , legal_prot = sum(mov.prot[], na.rm=T), og_def = sum(mov.def[], na.rm=T))

sum.bc<-rbindlist(list(denning.sum,rust.sum,cwd.sum,cav.sum,mov.sum))
sum.bc$p_legal_prot<-sum.bc$legal_prot/sum.bc$total
sum.bc$p_og_def<-sum.bc$og_def/sum.bc$total
```




### Protections in future habitat -- recovery overlap
```{r}
fisher.habitat.30yrs <- readRDS("C:/Users/klochhea/castor/R/scenarios/fisher_cclup/fisher.habitat.30yrs.rds")
userdb <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), dbname = paste0(here::here(), "/R/scenarios/fisher_cclup/rcb_castordb.sqlite") )
ras.info<-dbGetQuery(userdb, "Select * from raster_info limit 1;")
ras<-raster(extent(ras.info$xmin, ras.info$xmax, ras.info$ymin, ras.info$ymax), nrow = ras.info$nrow, ncol = ras.info$ncell/ras.info$nrow, vals =0)
dbDisconnect(userdb)

denning<-ras
denning[fisher.habitat.30yrs$pixelid]<-fisher.habitat.30yrs$denning
rust<-ras
rust[fisher.habitat.30yrs$pixelid]<-fisher.habitat.30yrs$rust
cwd<-ras
cwd[fisher.habitat.30yrs$pixelid]<-fisher.habitat.30yrs$cwd
cav<-ras
cav[fisher.habitat.30yrs$pixelid]<-fisher.habitat.30yrs$cavity
mov<-ras
mov[fisher.habitat.30yrs$pixelid]<-fisher.habitat.30yrs$movement


den.prot<-denning * prot.ras2
den.def<-denning * og_def2
denning.sum<-data.table(hab = 'denning', total =sum(denning[], na.rm=T) , legal_prot = sum(den.prot[], na.rm=T), og_def = sum(den.def[], na.rm=T))

rust.prot<-rust * prot.ras2
rust.def<-rust * og_def2
rust.sum<-data.table(hab = 'rust', total =sum(rust[], na.rm=T) , legal_prot = sum(rust.prot[], na.rm=T), og_def = sum(rust.def[], na.rm=T))

cwd.prot<-cwd * prot.ras2
cwd.def<-cwd * og_def2
cwd.sum<-data.table(hab = 'cwd', total =sum(cwd[], na.rm=T) , legal_prot = sum(cwd.prot[], na.rm=T), og_def = sum(cwd.def[], na.rm=T))

cav.prot<-cav * prot.ras2
cav.def<-cav * og_def2
cav.sum<-data.table(hab = 'cavity', total =sum(cav[], na.rm=T) , legal_prot = sum(cav.prot[], na.rm=T), og_def = sum(cav.def[], na.rm=T))

mov.prot<-mov * prot.ras2
mov.def<-mov * og_def2
mov.sum<-data.table(hab = 'movement', total =sum(mov[], na.rm=T) , legal_prot = sum(mov.prot[], na.rm=T), og_def = sum(mov.def[], na.rm=T))

sum.bc<-rbindlist(list(denning.sum,rust.sum,cwd.sum,cav.sum,mov.sum))
sum.bc$p_legal_prot<-sum.bc$legal_prot/sum.bc$total
sum.bc$p_og_def<-sum.bc$og_def/sum.bc$total
```
